records.title: FCC seeks comment on Lumos petition to preempt Stark and Mahoning permitting rules
records.evidence_summary: Public notice DA 26-689 opened WC Docket No. 26-167 on Lumos Fiber of Ohio's June 18, 2026 Section 253 petition, which asks the FCC to preempt Stark County's per-foot construction charges, inspection fees, and professional-survey requirement and Mahoning County's professional-survey requirement. Comments were due August 24 and reply comments September 23, 2026. Until the FCC rules, the two-county build remains blocked.

records.title: Stark and Mahoning counties retain counsel to fight Lumos FCC petition
records.evidence_summary: The Vindicator reports both counties hired Washington, D.C. telecom attorney Gerard Lederer (Best Best & Krieger) to oppose the petition, with Mahoning paying up front and Stark reimbursing half. Lumos says Stark's $1-per-foot fee and $55-$75-per-hour inspection charges would raise project cost about 50% (23% of expected five-year revenue there); trade press reports the abandoned two-county builds would have reached roughly 200,000 households.

records.title: Battle Ground issues stop-work order on new Metronet boring and trenching
records.evidence_summary: Effective July 31, 2026 the city halted all new Metronet boring and trenching in the public right-of-way after residents reported property damage and poor notice; restoration, repairs, and safety work may continue. Metronet says it paused voluntarily before the order. Work resumes neighborhood by neighborhood once Metronet supplies a construction schedule, proves advance notice, and confirms crews were briefed on Washington's Dig Law. Washington is not a Brightspeed state; the item is retained as an execution-risk signal.

records.title: Metronet launches $48M fiber build in Jackson, Summit Township, Vandercook Lake, and Blackman Township
records.evidence_summary: Metronet announced a $48 million privately funded build serving tens of thousands of homes and businesses across the four Jackson County communities, with construction slated to begin in October 2025 and residential service sold as T-Mobile Fiber. Jackson County is on Brightspeed's Michigan list.

records.title: Lumos plans nearly 100,000-passing Birmingham metro build
records.evidence_summary: Lumos's inaugural Alabama build covers nearly 1,300 miles reaching nearly 100,000 passings in Birmingham, Irondale, Mountain Brook, Homewood, Vestavia Hills, Hoover, and unincorporated Jefferson County; engineering had started and Hoover had approved a franchise agreement. Construction progress since 2025 has not been verified from public sources.

records.title: Metronet expands fiber network to Alexandria, Indiana
records.evidence_summary: Metronet announced a multimillion-dollar build reaching thousands of households and businesses, with construction starting soon and first customers expected by spring 2025. Madison County is on Brightspeed's Indiana list; current availability should be verified before use.

records.title: Metronet announces fiber build in Elwood, Indiana
records.evidence_summary: Metronet announced a fully funded multimillion-dollar build with construction starting soon and first customers expected by spring 2025. Madison County is on Brightspeed's Indiana list; current availability should be verified before use.

records.title: Metronet presents downtown installation schedule to New Bern board
records.source_name: City of New Bern board meeting
records.evidence_summary: The July 14, 2026 New Bern board agenda includes a Metronet presentation on its downtown installation schedule.

records.title: Metronet/T-Mobile fiber expansion active in Elm Grove
records.evidence_summary: The village says the Metronet/T-Mobile fiber network expansion project is currently expanding in Elm Grove.

records.title: Metronet construction advances into Grand Blanc neighborhoods
records.evidence_summary: The city identifies active and upcoming T-Mobile/Metronet work in the Genesee Road, Kings Pointe, Riverbend West, and Kirkridge areas.

records.title: T-Mobile reiterates multi-year T-Fiber expansion target
records.evidence_summary: T-Mobile targets 12–15 million T-Fiber households passed and 3–4 million T-Fiber customers by 2030 across its fiber platforms, including Metronet.

records.title: Lumos installation underway across Benson
records.evidence_summary: The town says T-Mobile is installing Lumos fiber throughout Benson and publishes maps for current and upcoming construction areas.

records.title: Howland reports ongoing Lumos fiber installation
records.evidence_summary: Howland describes ongoing fiber work and an August 11 coordination meeting with Lumos, Omni Fiber, Brightspeed, and Spectrum.

records.title: T-Mobile Fiber/Lumos construction begins in New Franklin
records.evidence_summary: New Franklin reports that T-Mobile Fiber/Lumos construction has begun. Summit County is not listed in Brightspeed's published county footprint.

records.title: Lumos says Stark and Mahoning deployments are blocked by permitting terms
records.evidence_summary: Lumos says local permitting requirements made the planned Stark and Mahoning County deployments economically unworkable and prompted an FCC petition. The FCC's Wireline Competition Bureau opened WC Docket No. 26-167 on the petition on July 8, 2026 (comments due August 24, replies September 23, 2026); both counties retained outside counsel and oppose it.

records.title: Orange County reports Lumos ARPA fiber build complete
records.evidence_summary: The county's September 2, 2026 update says all $10 million in ARPA funds are spent and the final June 2026 expansion (polygons 82 and 83) delivered fiber access to its 104 locations around the end of July 2026. 5,963 locations (93.6% of the original 6,370-location agreement) are served under the Lumos agreement, with 402 more addresses covered by a separate Stop Gap program.

records.title: Roselle reports active Lumos fiber installation
records.evidence_summary: Village material says Lumos has a master license agreement and is actively installing fiber. Cook and DuPage are not in Brightspeed's published Illinois county list.

records.title: Lumos plans 226,000-address Lorain and Cuyahoga expansion
records.evidence_summary: Lumos announced nearly 3,000 miles of fiber reaching 226,000 addresses across 27 communities, with construction scheduled to begin in late 2025.

records.title: Lumos announces 110,000-location Columbus metro build
records.evidence_summary: Lumos announced more than 1,000 miles reaching 110,000 homes and businesses in the Columbus metro, with engineering underway and construction scheduled for the first half of 2025.

records.title: Lumos reports construction pace near 50,000 passings per month
records.evidence_summary: Lumos says its accelerated network build and market expansion reached approximately 50,000 new passings per month.
